mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.code = 'admin' WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND r.code = 'admin' WHERE u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND u.id <> #{userId}
